desc: The Frigidaire 24" Radiant Smoothtop Freestanding Range features a powerful fan convection system that delivers consistent, more-even baking results, every time. For easier clean up, the oven features a smooth glass cooktop and Hidden Bake.
hl: Our fan convection system uses a powerful convection fan to evenly circulate heat around the oven cavity, resulting in more even baking and browning every time.
This 24" electric range is compact in design and fits perfectly into smaller kitchens without compromising on interior capacity.
Smooth glass cooktop is easy to clean
The smooth, glass design of the cooktop seamlessly integrates with your countertop, making it easy to clean.
The lower heating elements are beneath the oven floor, making for a smooth surface that is easy to clean.
Convenient storage drawer offers extra space to store your cookware.
